summary: Infosys Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing its quarterly results of operations and financial condition for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, under IFRS and Ind-AS. The board also approved the appointment of Ashiss Kumar Dash as CEO Designate until March 31, 2027, and as CEO and Managing Director from April 1, 2027. Additionally, the board granted 9,836 RSUs to new hires and approved incorporation of a step-down wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore. This is a routine earnings and governance update; no special situation event such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or tender offer is present. The CEO appointment is a planned succession, not a forced or abrupt change.
